text: Databases are essential for storing and organizing information. There are two main types: SQL and NoSQL. SQL databases use tables with rows and columns, which makes them great for structured data. NoSQL databases are more flexible and can handle unstructured data like documents or social media posts. To get information from a database, we use queries, which are special commands written in a language like SQL. Data modeling helps us plan how data connects before we build anything. Indexes are also important because they speed up searches, just like an index in a book helps you find pages faster.
